prompt: The runnable project in evals/files/backend-budgetless exposes its real inventory HTTP endpoint. The project has no benchmark framework or p95 budget. Measure the current /report path, find the dominant cost, and make the smallest behavior-preserving optimization. Keep filtered output and ordering unchanged, then report raw before/after samples and the ratio.
expected_output: The response measures the real HTTP path before changing code, identifies the repeated all-item scanning as the dominant cause, preserves duplicate removal, report fields and ordering, and reports comparable raw samples, aggregates and a behavior check.
assertions: The baseline measures the production HTTP endpoint rather than a copied benchmark algorithm.
The response identifies repeated all-item scanning as the dominant cost.
The candidate preserves duplicate removal, report fields and ordering.
The response reports raw before/after samples, an aggregate and the ratio.
The edited project's focused test passes.
